cells.old: Mandatory. Only letters A-Z and digits 0-9. Alphanumeric only for PA (up to 16) and CD (up to 11); digits only for TI (up to 11), CC (up to 10), RC (up to 11), CE (up to 7), PE (15), PT (up to 8) and PC (PEP-TUTOR, up to 16). The operator validates that the payer's document type and number differ from the pensioner's (pension type 16 foreign pensioners excepted). This validation applies to payments made from 1 October 2026. Source: AT3 v15 §2.2.1 campo 8, pp. 22-23; p. 39; §2.2.2.2 type 16, p. 46; ch. 5 §5.32, pp. 132-133.

The operator validates that the payer's document type and number differ from the pensioner's (pension type 16 foreign pensioners excepted). This validation applies to payments made from 1 October 2026. Source: AT3 v15 §2.2.1 campo 8, pp. 22-23; p. 39; §2.2.2.2 type 16, p. 46; ch. 5 §5.32, pp. 132-133. NOTE ON PC: PC (PEP-TUTOR) is NOT in the AT3 v15 (24-07-2026) value list of campo 7 (CC, CE, TI, RC, PA, CD, PE, PT) and appears only in the length rule of campo 8; the same inconsistency exists in AT2 v30 (24-07-2026) (PC 'hasta 8' in the type 1 file, 'hasta 16' in record type 2). PC is not added as a valid document type; its length must be checked with the operador (AT2 v30 (24-07-2026) pp.81-82; AT3 v15 (24-07-2026) pp.22-23).
